system.description:
Functions as a Detect Magic spell with a range of 20 feet. The wand's user gets a vague sense of what sort of magic is being detected. Always active when held, does not use charges.

A slender wand of clear quartz, fitted with a violet-blue crystal at the tip that glimmers with an inner light near enchantment.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A slim, smoothly finished stick about 18" (45 cm) long, the wand fits comfortably in one hand. Its surface shows faint runes and hairline veins; one end tapers to a rounded tip while the other terminates in a small carved motif. It feels surprisingly light and balanced.
